candidates.change_summary: Changed the return expression to only check IAccessControl (removed IERC165 check), so supportsInterface returns true only for IAccessControl and false for IERC165.
Changed supportsInterface to always return false, making it differ for any interface that previously returned true.
Changed supportsInterface to always return true, so every interface id will be reported as supported.
Reversed the original OR logic to only call super.supportsInterface (removing the direct check for IAccessControl), so support depends solely on ERC165 behavior.
Negated the equality check so it returns true when interfaceId is NOT IAccessControl, flipping the reported support for that id.
Change hasRole to invert stored boolean by returning !members[account] instead of members[account].
Change hasRole to always return true (ignores stored members).
Change hasRole to always return false (ignores stored members).
Change hasRole to treat address(0) as always having any role (returns true if account==address(0) else stored value).
Change hasRole to treat address(this) as always having any role (returns true if account==address(this) else stored value).
